purpose: Immutable subjects and normalized execution controls for the Phase 0 -> Phase 14-P comparison.

phase0.note: controlSha differs from packageSha only by the Phase 0 benchmark workflow/harness; package runtime source is unchanged between the two commits. The historical Phase 0 subject has no committed package-lock.json, so npm ci cannot be used without fabricating a lockfile. Its normalized install therefore preserves the original Phase 0 npm-install strategy while pinning the same npm executable used for the current subject.

currentPreRecovery.note: dbed974 is the authoritative Phase 14 closure head; c2b8eb0 is the functional package control point recorded by that closure document. The frozen current lockfile is preserved rather than replacing it with a newly-resolved dependency graph.

normalizedEnvironment.ffmpeg: Ubuntu 24.04 apt package; exact version captured in every benchmark artifact
normalizedEnvironment.gc: node --expose-gc; explicit GC before timed samples

controls.installStrategyException: Phase 0 has no historical lockfile; npm install is unavoidable. Install time is not part of any measured workload.

fixtures.raster: Deterministic solid-color PNGs generated by the shared normalized harness using its built-in PNG encoder; identical bytes are supplied to both subjects.
fixtures.network: No network fixtures are used by the normalized representative workloads.
